parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 75 bpm with normal axis and narrow QRS, and ST segments are isoelectric in all leads with no ST elevation, reciprocal ST depression or pathological Q waves, so the ECG does not meet STEMI criteria. The prominent T waves in V2–V3 are within normal limits, so the team's STEMI impression is not supported by this tracing.
